name: Abyssal Blade
desc:
Active: Overwhelm Stuns a target enemy unit for %stun_duration% seconds.

Pierces Debuff Immunity.

Passive: Bash Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%.
lore: The lost blade of the Commander of the Abyss, this edge cuts into an enemy's soul.

name: Aegis of the Immortal
desc:
Passive: Reincarnation Brings you to life with full health and mana %reincarnate_time% seconds after you die, at the location where you died.

Reincarnation must be used within %disappear_time_minutes_tooltip% minutes or Aegis of the Immortal disappears. If it expires, it will heal you over 5 seconds (dispels on damage).
lore: The Immortal was said to own a shield that protected him from death itself.

name: Aeon Disk
desc:
Passive: Combo Breaker When you take damage and your health falls below %health_threshold_pct%%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a %buff_duration% second buff that provides +%status_resistance%% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel
lore: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.

name: Aether Lens
lore: Polished with the incantation of his final breath, the gift of a dying mage to his sickly son.

name: Aghanim's Blessing
desc: Passive: Ability UpgradeUpgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

name: Aghanim's Blessing - Roshan
desc: Passive: Ability UpgradeUpgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

name: Aghanim's Scepter
desc: Passive: Ability UpgradeUpgrades the ultimate, and some abilities, of all heroes.
lore: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

name: Aghanim's Shard
desc: Passive: Ability UpgradeUpgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

name: Aghanim's Shard - Consumable
desc: Passive: Ability UpgradeUpgrades an existing ability or adds a new ability to your hero.
lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.

name: Ancient Guardian
desc: Passive: Ancient Power Grants %extra_bonus_damage% extra bonus damage as long as the unit is within %radius% range of an ancient.

name: Apex
lore: Three orbs of remarkable power bound within a single scepter.

name: Arcane Blink
desc:
Active: Arcane Blink Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you restore %heal_amount% health and %mana_amount% mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: A revitalizing tool to help bear the weight of arcane expenditure.

name: Arcane Boots
desc:
Active: ReplenishRestores %replenish_amount% mana to all nearby allies.

Radius: %replenish_radius%

Passive: Basilius AuraGrants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Magi equipped with these boots are valued in battle.

name: Arcane Ring
desc:
Active: Replenish Mana Restores mana equal to %mana_restore% + %mana_restore_pct%% of the caster's maximum mana pool to all nearby allies.

 Radius: %radius%
lore: Once a prized heirloom of a minor lord's house.

name: Arcanist's Armor
desc:
Active: Mega Shield Force Field Aura Grants %active_reflection_pct%% Damage Reflection for 5 seconds.

Passive: Shield Grants +%bonus_aoe_armor% armor and +%bonus_aoe_mres%% Magic Resistance to all other allies within %bonus_aoe_radius% radius.
lore: An exquisite piece commissioned by a paranoid monarch who choked on a piece of fruit long before the item saw its intended use.

name: Armlet of Mordiggian
desc:
Toggle: Unholy StrengthWhen active, Unholy Strength grants +%unholy_bonus_damage% damage, +%unholy_bonus_strength% strength and +%unholy_bonus_armor% armor, but drains %unholy_health_drain_per_second% health per second.

 You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.
lore: Weapon of choice among brutes, the bearer sacrifices his life energy to gain immense strength and power.

name: Ascetic's Cap
desc: Passive: EnduranceWhenever a debuff would be applied to the owner, grant %status_resistance%% Status resistance and %slow_resistance%% Slow Resistance for %duration% seconds.
lore: An austere hat thought to be of Turstarkuri origin.

name: Ash Legion Shield
desc: Active: Shield WallReduce your own movement speed by %slow% to provide a %block_amount% physical damage barrier to allied player controlled targets in a %block_radius% unit radius. Lasts for %duration% seconds.

name: Assault Cuirass
desc:
Passive: Assault Aura Grants %aura_attack_speed% attack speed and %aura_positive_armor% armor to nearby allied units and structures, and decreases nearby enemy unit and structure armor by %aura_negative_armor%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: Forged in the depths of the nether reaches, this hellish mail provides an army with increased armor and attack speed.

name: Aviana's Feather
desc: Passive: Free Bird When equipped hero is below %flight_threshold%% HP, they gain flying movement.

name: Bag of Gold
desc: Contains gold

name: Ballista
desc: Passive: Knockback Knocks back enemies %knockback_distance% distance and deals %bonus_damage% pure damage with every attack.
lore: A simple design much improved by a master smith's loving hand.

name: Band of Elvenskin
lore: A tensile fabric often used for its light weight and ease of movement.

name: Battle Fury
desc:
Active: Chop Tree Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %quelling_bonus% for melee heroes, and %quelling_bonus_ranged% for ranged.

Passive: Cleave Deals %cleave_damage_percent%% of attack damage as physical damage in a cone up to %cleave_distance% around the target. Deals %cleave_damage_percent_creep%% against creeps. (Melee Only)
lore: The bearer of this mighty axe gains the ability to cut down swaths of enemies at once.

name: Beloved Memory
desc: Active: Honor the DeadPlace this Offering on an Altar to honor the dead with a memory from those they left behind.
lore: Take joy in remembering those beloved who've passed now beyond the veil.

name: Belt of Strength
lore: A valued accessory for improving vitality.

name:
Black Grimoire
(Warlock)
desc:
Use: Profane KnowledgeHero kills and assists empower the Black Grimoire, granting it charges. Right-click to consume and grant %xp_per_charge% experience per charge. Starts on cooldown.
This item cannot be dropped.

name: Black King Bar
desc:
Active: Avatar Applies a basic dispel. Grants %spell_reduce%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Duration: %duration%s
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: A powerful staff imbued with the strength of giants.

name: Blade Mail
desc:
Active: Damage ReturnFor %duration% seconds, return all incoming damage, increasing the percentage by %active_reflection_pct%%.

Passive: Damage ReturnEverytime you are attacked, you return %passive_reflection_constant% damage plus %passive_reflection_pct%% of the attack damage dealt to you.
lore: A razor-sharp coat of mail, it is the choice of selfless martyrs in combat.

name: Blade of Alacrity
lore: A long blade imbued with time magic.

name: Blades of Attack
lore: The damage of these small, concealable blades should not be underestimated.

name: Blast Rig
desc: Passive: Hair Trigger The next time you get attacked by a hero within %radius% range, explode dealing %damage% damage to all enemies within a %radius% radius and causing them to miss %blind_pct%% of their attacks for %blind_duration% seconds.
lore: One of a set of custom rigs once worn by infamous road agents in the Outlands, its siblings have been lost to misfires and the various tides of time.

name: Blink Dagger
desc:
Active: Blink Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

Blink Dagger cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: The fabled dagger used by the fastest assassin ever to walk the lands.

name: Blitz Knuckles
lore: An underground arcanist's update of a back-alley classic.

name: Block of Cheese
desc: Use: ScrumptiousTry me!
lore: First there was the Belt of Strength. Then there were the Boots of Travel. Now, at long last, the Block of Cheese.

name: Blood Grenade
desc: Use: Throw Grenade Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration% seconds. Radius %radius%.
lore: Both the hunter and the hunted must pay the blood price.

name: Bloodstone
desc:
Active: Bloodpact Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to %spell_lifesteal_while_active%%. Lasts %buff_duration% seconds.

Passive: Spell Weakness Aura Enemy units take %aura_spell_vulnerability%% increased damage from spells.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: The Bloodstone's bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.

name: Bloodthorn
desc:
Active: Soul Rend Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.

Passive: PierceGrants each attack a %proc_chance%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.
lore: A reviled blade that bites deeper with each wriggle of its victim's final throes.

name: Book of Shadows
desc:
Active: ShadowsTarget an enemy, ally or self. Causes the target to become untargetable from enemies to the caster, but also silenced, muted and disarmed for %duration% seconds. Applies a Basic Dispel.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: An impossible tome filled with unreadable prose of unknowable thoughts.

name: Book of the Dead
desc: Active: Greater Demonic Summoning Summon 2 demonic warriors and 2 demonic archers that last %summon_duration% seconds. The Warrior burns mana every hit and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a basic dispel ability with a slow and a passive movement speed aura.
lore: A record of the final reckoning. With one page torn out.

name: Boots of Bearing
desc:
Active: Endurance Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds. For the first %bonus_ms_duration% seconds allies are immune to slows.

 Radius: %radius%

Passive: Swiftness AuraGrants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %radius%
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Resplendent footwear fashioned for the ancient herald that first dared spread the glory of Stonehall beyond the original borders of its nascent claim.

name: Boots of Speed
desc: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Fleet footwear, increasing movement.

name: Boots of Travel
desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal ScrollUpgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Winged boots that grant omnipresence.

name: Boots of Travel 2
desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal ScrollUpgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Winged boots that grant omnipresence.

name: Bottle
desc:
Active: RegenerateConsumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive:  Store RuneRunes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
lore: An old bottle that survived the ages, the contents placed inside become enchanted.

name: Bracer
lore: The bracer is a common choice to toughen up defenses and increase longevity.

name: Brigand's Blade
desc: Passive: Dark MercyYour attacks deal %bonus_damage% more damage to enemies for each %missing_hp%% HP they are missing.
lore: An infamous assassin's blade stolen and smuggled out of White Spire after its owner's mysterious demise.

name: Broadsword
lore: The classic weapon of choice for knights, this blade is sturdy and reliable for slaying enemies.

name: Broom Handle
lore: The surprisingly dangerous creation of an apprentice sorcerer with a strange fondness for brooms.

name: Buckler
desc:
Passive: Buckler Aura Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%
lore: A powerful shield that imbues the bearer with the strength of heroes past, it is capable of protecting entire armies in battle.

name: Bullwhip
desc: Active: WhipGrants %speed%% movement speed when cast on allies, and slows by %speed%% when cast on enemies. Lasts %duration% seconds.
lore: Once the favored lash of an infamous broker of pit fighters and other live trade.

name: Butterfly
lore: Only the mightiest and most experienced of warriors can wield the Butterfly, but it provides incredible dexterity in combat.

name: Ceremonial Robe
desc:
Passive: Ceremonial AuraLowers enemy Status Resistance by %status_resistance%% and Magic Resistance by %magic_resistance%%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: One of many items lost in the looting of Zelenwyr's sacred reliquary.

name: Chainmail
lore: A medium weave of metal chains.

name: Cheese
desc: Use: Fondue Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.
lore: Made from the milk of a long lost Furbolg vendor, it restores the vitality of those who taste it.

name: Chipped Vest
desc: Passive: ChipperEvery time you are attacked, you return %damage_return_hero% damage to heroes and %damage_return_creep% damage to creeps.
lore: It doesn't look like much, but it's oddly comfy.

name: Circlet
lore: An elegant circlet designed for human princesses.

name: Clarity
desc:
Use: Replenish Grants %mana_regen% mana regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
lore: Clear water that enhances the ability to meditate.

name: Claymore
lore: A sword that can cut through armor, it's a commonly chosen first weapon for budding swordsmen.

name: Cloak
lore: A cloak made of a magical material that works to dispel any magic cast on it.

name: Cloak of Flames
desc: Passive: ImmolateBurns enemy units in a %radius% unit radius for %damage% damage per second. Illusions deal %damage_illusions% damage per second.
lore: A very fine cloak that plays host to an overly-protective living flame.

name: Clumsy Net
desc: Active: Ensnare Ensnares the target enemy and yourself for %duration% seconds.

name: Conjurer's Catalyst
desc: Passive: Spellover Dealing %damage_threshold% spell damage to an enemy causes them to overheat and deal damage to their allies in a %damage_aoe% unit radius. Hero targets deal %damage% damage to their allies, other targets deal %damage_creep% damage.

name: Consecrated Wraps
desc:
Passive: Hallowed Gain a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime%s, up to a maximum of %AbilityCharges% charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by %movement_speed_pct_on_stack_gain%% for %duration%s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for %duration%s that absorbs %barrier_per_stack% damage per charge (%max_barrier_tooltip% max).

name: Cornucopia
lore: A source of spiritual and physical nourishment.

name: Craggy Coat
desc: Active: Toughen Up Grants you an extra %active_armor% bonus armor at the cost of -%move_speed% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration% seconds.

name: Crella's Crozier
desc:
Active: Rite of Rumusque You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second. Movement speed steal lasts %stack_duration%s.

Putrefaction Aura's effect is increased to %active_health_steal%%. All of the lost Health Restoration is redirected to you every second.

Passive: Putrefaction AuraReduces nearby enemy heroes' Health Restoration by %health_steal%%.

Radius: %radius%

name: Crimson Guard
desc:
Active: Guard For %duration% seconds, grant nearby allied heroes and buildings a %block_chance_active%% chance to block damage equal to %block_damage_active% plus %max_hp_pct%% of the caster's max health value from each incoming attack.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%

Passive: Damage Block Grants a %block_chance%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
lore: A cuirass originally built to protect against the dreaded Year Beast.

name: Crippling Crossbow
desc: Active: HobbleHits an enemy for %damage% damage, then slows them by %slow_pct%% and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduce%% for %duration% seconds. The slow gradually fades over the duration of the spell.
lore: The ever-weeping woodgrain of this crossbow coats every bolt in a potent but short-lived narcotic sap.

name: Crown
lore: A stately crown created to ensure a well-meaning but ungifted heir could fend off usurpers and govern with a strong hand.

name: Crystalys
desc: Passive: Critical StrikeGrants each attack a %crit_chance%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%% damage.
lore: A blade forged from rare crystals, it seeks weak points in enemy armor.

name: Daedalus
desc: Passive: Critical StrikeGrants each attack a %crit_chance%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%% damage.
lore: A weapon of incredible power that is difficult for even the strongest of warriors to control.

name: Dagger of Ristul
desc: Active: Imbrue Consume health to temporarily gain %bonus_damage% damage for %duration% seconds.
lore: A sinister shiv that grants favor to those willing to stain its blade with a sacrifice of their own blood.

desc:
Active: Energy Burst Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
 Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
lore: A lesser wand that grows in power the longer it is used, it brings magic to the fingertips of the user.

name: Dandelion Amulet
desc: Passive: Magical Damage Block Every %AbilityCooldown%s, blocks up to %magic_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.

name: Defiant Shell
desc: Passive: Reciprocity When attacked, the hero counter-attacks a target within their attack range for %counter_damage%% of their regular attack damage.

name: Demon Edge
lore: One of the oldest weapons forged by the Demon-Smith Abzidian, it killed its maker when he tested its edge.

name: Desolator
desc:
Passive: Corruption Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.

Passive: Soul Stealer Desolator gains +%bonus_damage_per_kill% damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of %max_damage%.
lore: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.

name: Dezun Bloodrite
desc: Passive: Blood Invocation Spells have a %aoe_pct%% larger Area of Effect, but now additionally cost health equal to %health_pct%% of their mana cost.
lore: The gateway to a lost lineage of power, unlocked only with blood.

name: Diadem
lore: A crown that can never be removed.

name: Diffusal Blade
desc:
Active: Inhibit Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.

Passive: ManabreakEach attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.

name: Diffusal Blade
lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.

name: Disgraced Regalia
desc: Passive: Fallen You have died and thus get nothing.
lore: It cannot abide failure.

name: Disperser
desc:
Active: Suppress Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: ManabreakEach attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.

Illusions do not burn mana.
lore: Once entrusted to an Apostle General of the Rumusque Faithful's expeditionary force.

name: Divine Rapier
desc:
Toggle: Transmute Toggle to gain either %bonus_spell_amp%% bonus spell amplification or %bonus_damage% bonus attack damage.

Passive: Everlasting Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.
lore: So powerful, it cannot have a single owner.

name: Divine Regalia
desc: Passive: Exalted Increases outgoing damage by %outgoing_damage%%. Dying permanently disables this Neutral Item and the current Enchantment is lost.
lore: So magnificent, it cannot abide failure.

name: Dormant Curio
desc: Passive: Hidden PotentialNeutral Artifacts you craft while holding a Dormant Curio have their potency increased by %item_potency%%.
lore: Everyone has an idea, but no one has a clue.

name: Doubloon
desc: Toggle: Flip Toggle to convert %conversion_pct%% of your Max Health to Max Mana, or %conversion_pct%% of your Max Mana to Max Health.

name: Dragon Lance
lore: The forward charge of the wyvern host grants no quarter.

name: Dragon Scale
desc: Passive: Afterburn Causes attacks to burn the enemy, dealing %damage_per_sec% damage per second for %duration% seconds. Affects buildings.
lore: The remains of a dragon always outvalue the wealth of even the most prodigious hoard.

name: Drum of Endurance
desc:
Active: Endurance Gives +%bonus_attack_speed_pct% attack speed and +%bonus_movement_speed_pct%% movement speed to nearby allies for %duration% seconds.

Radius: %radius%

Passive: Swiftness AuraGrants %aura_movement_speed% movement speed and %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %radius%
lore: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

name: Duelist Gloves
desc: Passive: Boldness Grants %bonus_attack_speed% attack speed as long as there are enemy heroes within %radius% units.

name: Dust of Appearance
desc:
Use: RevealFor %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.

 The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
lore: One may hide visage, but never volume.

name: Eaglesong
lore: Capturing the majestic call of an eagle, this mystical horn brings limitless dexterity to those who hear it.

name: Echo Sabre
desc: Passive: Echo Strike Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
lore: A deceptively swift blade imbued with resonant magic.

name: Eldwurm's Edda
desc: Passive: Forbidden KnowledgeWhen consumed, increases Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %intellect_pct%% of its current value at the time of consumption, and increases the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one. All values except for Mana Cost scale by 50% of the difference between their existing levels for the additional level

name: Elixir
desc:
Use: Consume Restores %health% health and %mana% mana to the target over %duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

name: Elven Tunic
lore: Even simple items of elven make seem imbued with inexplicable efficacy.

name: Enchanted Mango
desc: Use: Eat Mango Instantly restores %replenish_amount% mana.
lore: The bittersweet flavors of Jidi Isle are irresistible to amphibians.

name: Enchanted Quiver
desc: Passive: Certain Strike Empowers your next attack with %bonus_damage% bonus magical damage and True Strike. Ranged Attackers have +%active_bonus_attack_range% bonus range for the attack.
lore: A graceful gift blessed by the goddess of the hunt.

name: Enchanter's Bauble
desc: Passive: Enchant Increases the bonuses of the item's Neutral Enchantment by %enchantment_bonus_base%%. Every time this item is crafted again the bonus is increased by %enchantment_bonus_growth%%.

name: Energy Booster
lore: This lapis gemstone is commonly added to the collection of wizards seeking to improve their presence in combat.

name: Essence Distiller
desc:
Active: Soul Release Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies.

Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to %ground_duration%s and attach to the first enemy that comes within %latch_range% radius. When on enemies, deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.

name: Essence Ring
desc: Active: Life Essence Increases your current and max health by %health_gain% for %health_gain_duration% seconds.
lore: An ancient bauble blessed by the breath of Verodicia.

name: Eternal Shroud
desc:
Passive: Shroud Restores mana equal to %mana_restore_pct%% of incoming enemy spell damage before reductions.

Passive: Eternal Endurance For every %stack_threshold% spell damage that equipped hero receives, it gains a stack of Endurance for %stack_duration%s up to a maximum of %max_stacks% charges. Each charge increases Eternal Shroud's magic resistance by %stack_resist%% .
lore: A pristine hood that feeds upon strife to empower its owner.

name: Ethereal Blade
desc:
Active: Ether BlastConverts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and %ethereal_damage_bonus%% more vulnerable to magic damage.

  Enemy targets are also slowed by %blast_movement_slow%%, and take %blast_stat_multiplier%x the sum of all your attributes + %blast_damage_base% as magical damage.
Duration: %duration% seconds
lore: A flickering blade of a ghastly nature, it is capable of dealing damage in both magical and physical planes.

name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
desc:
Active: Cyclone Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: A mysterious scepter passed down through the ages, its disruptive winds can be used for good or evil.

name: Ex Machina
desc: Active: Reset Cooldowns Reset the cooldown on all items (except Refresher Orb).
lore: The remains of an ancient universe, preserved within a single sphere.

name: Eye of Skadi
desc: Passive: Cold Attack Attacks lower enemy movement by %cold_slow_melee%% if they are melee and %cold_slow_ranged%% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by %cold_attack_slow_melee%% and Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction%%. Lasts for %cold_duration% seconds.
lore: Extremely rare artifact, guarded by the azure dragons.

name: Eye of the Vizier
lore: The ring of a cunning court mage who imprisoned a cadre of enemies to serve as his personal mana reserve.

name: Faded Broach
lore: A life-saving jewel bestowed upon a young queen by a kindly vizier.

name: Fae Grenade
desc: Active: Shadow BrandThrows a Mark towards an enemy within %abilitycastrange% range applying a debuff that deals %dps% damage every second and provides vision of the unit for %duration% seconds.
lore: Those marked for death by the fae shine brightly to all manner of creatures in the shadow realm.

name: Faerie Fire
desc: Use: Imbue Instantly restores %hp_restore% health.
lore: The ethereal flames from the ever-burning ruins of Kindertree ignite across realities.

name: Fairy's Trinket
lore: A small token imbued with the fortune of the fae in recognition of an intriguing display of mortal kindness.

name: Falcon Blade
lore: An enchanted blade that long ago raised a hopeless urchin from pauper to king.

name: Fallen Sky
desc:
Active: Fallen Sky Transform into a meteor that strikes down at the target area after %land_time% seconds in a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage every %burn_interval% seconds to enemy units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds.

Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%
Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%

Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%
Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%

Fallen Sky cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: One of the few surviving creations of the acolytes of the Wyrmforge.

name: Flayer's Bota
desc:
Active: Bloodthirst Gain %base_damage%% base damage and %attack_speed% attack speed for %duration% seconds.

Passive: BloodrushEnemy heroes dying within %death_radius% units reset the cooldown of Bloodthirst.

name: Flicker
desc:
Active: Flicker Dispells debuffs and blinks you in a random forward direction for a random distance between %min_range% and %max_range%. If cast within 3 seconds of receiving player damage, it will blink in place.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: The technically-true-to-his-word 'teleportation device' crafted by a notorious fae trickster.

name: Fluffy Hat
lore: Fine and functional foppery for the fashion-forward fighter.

name: Forager's Kit
desc: Passive: ForageWhen the cooldown is ready, nearby trees that can be foraged will appear. By standing next to a tree for %AbilityChannelTime%s, you can forage the tree and find flora, fungi or a bag of gold containing %gold_amount% gold.

name: Force Boots
desc:
Active: ForcePushes the target %push_length% units in the direction they are facing. Dispels if cast on an ally.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Speed Unlock Completely removes the speed limit for the wearer
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Elusive marvels never successfully studied for proper classification in the archives.

name: Force Staff
desc: Active: ForcePushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
lore: Allows you to manipulate others, for good or evil.

name: Forebearer's Fortune
desc: Active: Undying PromiseSignal to the spirits of the other realm your commitment to honoring them. If everyone in the battle makes an Undying Promise before the fight begins, the dead might be willing to listen.
lore: This item seems unstable. Like it might just disappear.

name: Fusion Rune
desc: Use: Consume Grants the target the bonuses of every Power Rune for %duration% seconds. Each use consumes a charge.

name: Gale Guard
desc: Active: Cyclonic Shield Envelops the caster in an all damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_pct%% of incoming damage up to a max of %barrier_amount%. Lasts for up to %barrier_duration% seconds and while the barrier is active you have %slow_resist%% Slow Resistance.
lore: If one truly listens, they can always rely upon the wind to make its will known.

name: Gauntlets of Strength
lore: Studded leather gloves that add brute strength.

name: Gem of True Sight
desc:
Active: Reveal Gives True Sight over a %active_radius% radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.
Passive: True Sight Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %radius% range of its carrier.

Passive: EverlastingDropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
lore:
Not one thrall creature of the depths,
Nor spirit bound in drowning's keep,
Nor Maelrawn the Tentacular,
Shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.

name: Ghost Scepter
desc: Active: Ghost Form You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%% more vulnerable to magic damage.
lore: Imbues the wielder with a ghostly presence, allowing them to evade physical damage.

name: Giant's Maul
desc: Passive: Crushing Blow Empowers the next attack to be a critical hit dealing %crit_multiplier%% damage. Hitting an enemy with an empowered attack temporarily decreases their movement speed by %movespeed_slow%%, attack speed by %attack_slow%%, and cast speed by %cast_slow%% for %debuff_duration% seconds.
lore: Crude but smashingly effective.

name: Giant's Ring
desc: Passive: Giant's FootCan path over any terrain and deals %pct_str_damage_per_second%% of your strength per second to units you are standing ontop of.
lore: Prized procurement of an otherwise unremarkable ruler of Elze who abdicated his position and vanished.

name: Gleipnir
desc: Active: Eternal ChainsRoots all enemies in a %radius_tooltip% radius for %duration% seconds.
lore: Bindings forged by impossible means to leash an ancient evil.

name: Glimmer Cape
desc:
Active: Glimmer After a %initial_fade_delay% second delay, grants invisibility, %active_movement_speed% movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to %barrier_block% damage to you or a target allied unit for %duration% seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.
lore: The stolen cape of a master illusionist.

name: Gloves of Haste
lore: A pair of magical gloves that seems to render weapons weightless.

name: Gossamer Cape
desc: Passive: Sixth Sense Automatically dodge an attack from an enemy hero.

name: Great Healing Lotus
desc: Use: Eat Lotus Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.

name: Greater Faerie Fire
desc: Use: Imbue Instantly restores %hp_restore% health.

name: Greater Healing Lotus
desc: Use: Eat Lotus Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.

name: Gris-Gris
desc: This item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack but can be put into normal inventory slots. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

name: Grove Bow
desc: Passive: Magic Amp Reduces magic resistance of the attacked enemy by %magic_resistance_reduction%%.
lore: A gift from the moon goddess to one of her prized disciples many memories ago.

name: Guardian Greaves
desc:
Active: MendRestores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.

Radius: %replenish_radius%
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: Guardian Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below %aura_bonus_threshold%%, their health regeneration is increased to %aura_health_regen_bonus%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: One of many holy instruments constructed to honor the Omniscience.

name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
desc: Passive: Beat the Crowd Your next attack deals an additional %bonus_damage% magic damage and splashes to units within %splash_radius% units for %splash_pct%% of the original attack's damage plus the additional magic damage.
lore: A 'harmless' prank that went entirely too far.

name: Hand of Midas
desc:
Active: Transmute Kills a non-hero target for %bonus_gold% gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.

 Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
lore: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner's pockets.

name: Harmonizer
desc: Passive: Balance Gain %manacost_reduction%% spell mana cost reduction for every ability off cooldown and %spell_amp%% spell amplification for every ability on cooldown.

name: Harpoon
desc:
Active: Draw Forth When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to %pull_distance_pct%% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

Passive: Echo Strike Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: %passive_cooldown%s
lore: A perfect solution for the flight of foes.

name: Havoc Hammer
desc: Active: Havoc Pulls enemies in a %range% range around you, slowing them by %slow%% for %slow_duration% seconds and dealing %nuke_base_dmg% + %nuke_str_dmg%x your str as magical damage.

name: Headdress
desc:
Passive: Regeneration AuraGrants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: Creates a soothing aura that restores allies in battle.

name: Healing Lotus
desc: Use: Eat Lotus Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.

name: Healing Salve
desc:
Use: Salve Grants %health_regen% health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.
lore: A magical salve that can quickly mend even the deepest of wounds.

name: Heart of Tarrasque
desc: Passive: Behemoth's BloodYour health regeneration is increased by %missing_health_regen%% of your missing health.
lore: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.

name: Heaven's Halberd
desc: Active: DisarmPrevents a target from attacking for %disarm_melee% seconds.
lore: This halberd moves with the speed of a smaller weapon, allowing the bearer to win duels that a heavy edge would not.

name: Helm of Iron Will
lore: The helmet of a legendary warrior who fell in battle.

name: Helm of the Dominator
desc:
Active: DominateTakes control of one neutral, non-ancient target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen and +%creep_bonus_armor% armor.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster %bounty_pct%% of the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.

name: Helm of the Overlord
desc:
Active: DominateTakes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to %speed_base% and max health to a minimum of %health_min%. Also provides the unit with +%creep_bonus_damage% base attack damage, +%creep_bonus_hp_regen% health regen, +%creep_bonus_mp_regen% mana regen, +%creep_bonus_armor% armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than %health_min% retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to %bounty_gold% gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for %creep_damage_taken_cooldown% seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: The powerful headpiece of an undead necromancer.

name: Helm of the Undying
desc: Passive: Death Delay Survive for an extra %duration% seconds after receiving a killing blow. If any enemy heroes dies within %kill_radius% units, the death delay effect is extended by %bonus_kill_duration% seconds. The hero cannot attack buildings during Death Delay.
lore: The price for wearing it is paid in the afterlife.

name: Holy Locket
desc:
Active: Energy ChargeTarget an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by %incoming_heal_increase_active%% for %active_buff_duration%s and instantly restore %health_restore_per_charge% health and %mana_restore_per_charge% mana per charge stored.

Automatically gains a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% seconds and whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.

Passive: Holy BlessingAmplifies heals you provide by %heal_increase_passive%%.
lore: A prized relic long thought lost forever in a failed crusade.

name: Hood of Defiance
desc: Active: Barrier Creates a spell shield that absorbs up to %barrier_block% magical damage.  Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.
lore: A furred, magic resistant headpiece that is feared by wizards.

name: Hurricane Pike
desc:
Active: Hurricane Thrust Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
lore: A legendary pike once held as royal sigil of the ancient wyvern riders.

name: Hydra's Breath
desc:
Passive: MiasmaAttacks poison enemies, dealing %poison_damage_per_second%% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for %poison_duration% seconds.

Passive: PolycephalyRanged attacks have a %proc_chance%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%% damage of a normal attack.

name: Hyperstone
lore: A mystical, carved stone that boosts the fervor of the holder.

name: Idol of Scree'auk
desc: Active: False Flight Gain %slow_resist%% slow resistance, phased movement, and %evasion%% evasion for %duration% seconds.

name: Illusionist's Cape
desc:
Active: Create Illusion Creates an image under your control.
Passive: Illusion MasteryIncreases outgoing damage of all units and illusions controlled by the hero by %attack_damage_aura%%.
lore: A dashing cape whose creator insists on calling 'Cloak of Apparition' as opposed to his assistant's 'Illusion' drivel.

name: Imp Claw
desc: Passive: Critical Strike Empowers your next attack, causing it to be a critical strike dealing %crit_multiplier%% damage.
lore: Though their tasks are largely thankless, demon hunters can often turn a profit bartering parts in Weeping Rose.

name: Infused Raindrops
desc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.

Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
lore: Elemental protection from magical assaults.

name: Iron Branch
desc: Use: Plant Tree Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for %tree_duration% seconds.
lore: A seemingly ordinary branch, its ironlike qualities are bestowed upon the bearer.

name: Iron Talon
desc:
Active: ChopTargets a non-player enemy unit to remove %creep_damage_pct%% of its current HP.

If cast on a tree, instantly destroys it.
lore: A simple but effective weapon devised to quell a great Hellbear uprising.

name: Ironwood Nut
desc: Use: Munch Grants %bonus_stat% permanent primary attribute.

name: Ironwood Tree
desc: Use: Plant Tree Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for %tree_duration% seconds.
lore: Precious. And hearty as a weed.

name: Javelin
desc: Passive: PierceGrants each attack a %bonus_chance%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.
lore: A rather typical spear that can sometimes pierce through an enemy's armor when used to attack.

name: Jidi Pollen Bag
desc: Active: PollinateSpreads pollen on all enemy units in a %debuff_radius% unit radius for %debuff_duration% seconds, decreasing their health restoration by %health_regen_loss%% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to %hp_damage%% of their maximum health.
lore: Very dangerous. Very difficult to obtain more.

name: Kaya
lore: The staff of a renowned sorceress, lost for countless millennia.

name: Kaya and Sange
lore: Two of three known items of unimaginable power that many believe were crafted at the same enchanter's forge.

name: Keen Optic
lore: Stolen from a tinker's shop ages ago, this handy lens has seen service to many owners.

name: Khanda
desc: Passive: Empower Spell The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by %slow%% for %slow_duration%s.
lore: A blade sharp enough to slice through magic itself.

name: Kobold Cup
desc: Active: One for the RoadIncreases movement speed of all allied units by %movespeed_pct%% in a %buff_radius% unit radius around the caster for %buff_duration% seconds.
lore: The Kobold King will sip when he damn well pleases.

name: Lance of Pursuit
desc: Passive: Hound Attacking from behind slows enemies by %slow_pct_melee%% (%slow_pct_ranged%% if Ranged) and deals %backstab_damage% more damage. Slow lasts %slow_duration% second(s).
lore: The gleaming weapon of a tarnished knight haunted by his duties to an unworthy king.

name: Leviathan's Fish
desc: Yummy Fish

name: Light Collector
desc:
Active: Lightbreak Produce a brilliant flash of light that destroys trees in a %tree_destruction_radius% AoE.

Passive: Unclouded Provides wearer with health regeneration during the day and mana regeneration during the night. When within a %radius% distance of any trees, health and mana regeneration are decreased by %penalty%%.

name: Linken's Sphere
desc:
Passive: SpellblockBlocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.

Active: Transfer SpellblockTemporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for %block_cooldown% seconds.
lore: This magical sphere once protected one of the most famous heroes in history.

name: Lotus Orb
desc:
Active: Echo ShellApplies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: The jewel at its center still reflects a pale image of its creator.

name: Madstone Bundle
desc: Collect to craft new Neutral Items.

name: Maelstrom
desc: Passive: Chain LightningGrants a %chain_chance%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
lore: A hammer forged for the gods themselves, Maelstrom allows its user to harness the power of lightning.

name: Mage Slayer
desc: Passive: Mage SlayerPlaces a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.
lore: Forged by a secret order in The Third Age of Praxa'cia to fell the False King.

name: Magic Lamp
desc:
Passive: Rejuvenate When the wearer's health falls below %health_threshold%%, they will receive a strong dispel and be healed for %heal% health.

Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

name: Magic Stick
desc:
Active: Energy Charge Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

 Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

name: Magic Wand
desc:
Active: Energy ChargeInstantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
lore: A simple wand used to channel magic energies, it is favored by apprentice wizards and great warlocks alike.

name: Magnifying Monocle
desc: Passive: Keen Eye Increases cast range by %bonus_cast_range% and attack range by %bonus_attack_range% (Melee & Ranged). Taking over %damage_threshold% damage from a player controlled source or Roshan disables this effect for %damage_disable% seconds.
lore: Deadly refinement.

name: Mana Draught
desc:
Active: Bottoms UpRestores %mana_restore% + %mana_restore_pct%% of the caster's maximum mana over %heal_duration% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Fill UpCooldown Speed of Mana Draught is increased by %water_acceleration%% while in water.
lore: A refreshing drink best shared with friends.

name: Mango Tree
desc: Use: Plant a Mango Tree Targets the ground to plant a mango tree that provides unlimited mango power. The tree generates Enchanted Mangoes every %seconds% seconds, and provides unobstructed vision in the area .

name: Manta Style
desc:
Active: Mirror ImageCreates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.

Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%% damage.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: An axe made of reflective materials that causes confusion amongst enemy ranks.

name: Mantle of Intelligence
lore: A beautiful sapphire mantle worn by generations of queens.

name: Martyr's Plate
desc: Active: Martyrdom Redirect %damage_redirection%% of all magic damage dealt to your allied heroes within %aura_radius% radius towards you for %duration% seconds.

name: Mask of Madness
desc:
Active: BerserkGives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you.  Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.

Passive: LifestealHeals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.

name: Medallion of Courage
desc: Active: ValorIncreases armor by %ally_armor% or decreases armor by %enemy_armor% for %duration%s depending on if cast on an ally or enemy. Cannot be cast on self.

name: Mekansm
desc:
Active: RestoreRestores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.

Passive: Mekansm AuraGrants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
lore: A glowing jewel formed out of assorted parts that somehow fit together perfectly.

name: Mercy & Grace
desc: Active: Dead ShotFires a ghostly bullet at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes it will deal %damage% damage and slow the target by %impact_slow_percent%% for %impact_slow_duration% seconds, then ricochet in the vector-targeted direction. The ricochet will damage all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet will be feared for %ricochet_fear_duration% seconds in the direction of the shot.
lore: One to deliver the body, the other to claim the soul.

name: Metamorphic Mandible
desc: Active: Pupate Enter into an insect form for %duration% seconds, increasing magic resistance by %bonus_magic_resistance%% and movement speed by %bonus_movespeed%%. While an insect, your size is decreased and your armor is reduced by %armor_decrease%%.

name: Meteor Hammer
desc:
Active: Meteor Hammer CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for %burn_slow%% for the duration of the burn.

Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%
Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%

Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%
Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%

Channel Duration: %max_duration% seconds.
Landing Time: %land_time% seconds.
lore: An enchanted hammer forged of metals discovered in the ruins of a village destroyed by a great star storm.

name: Mind Breaker
desc: Passive: Silence Strike The next attack silences the hit enemy for %duration% seconds.
lore: A bewitching blade of indeterminate form capable of piercing the psyche of even the most willful foe.

name: Minotaur Horn
desc:
Active: Lesser AvatarApplies a basic dispel. Grants %magic_resist%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage for %duration%s. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: The trophy from a mighty beast ambushed and slain in the recesses of its own home.

name: Mirror Shield
desc: Passive: Echo Shield Block and reflect most targeted spells back to their caster once every %block_cooldown% seconds.
lore: The shield that long ago robbed the old one of his first memories.

name: Mithril Hammer
lore: A hammer forged of pure mithril.

name: Mjollnir
desc:
Active: Static ChargePlaces a charged shield on a target unit for %static_duration% seconds which has a %static_chance%% chance to release a %static_damage% magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and %static_strikes% additional enemies.

Passive: Chain LightningGrants a %chain_chance%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
lore: Thor's magical hammer, made for him by the dwarves Brok and Eitri.

name: Monkey King Bar
desc: Passive: PierceGrants each attack a %bonus_chance%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.
lore: A powerful staff used by a master warrior.

name: Moon Shard
desc:
Use: Consume Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.

Passive: Shade SightGrants bonus night vision.
lore: Said to be a tear from the lunar goddess Selemene.

name: Morbid Mask
desc: Passive: LifestealHeals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
lore: A mask that drains the energy of those caught in its gaze.

name: Mystic Staff
lore: Enigmatic staff made of only the most expensive crystals.

desc:
Active: Demonic SummoningSummons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for %summon_duration% seconds.

Warrior:Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it.  Gains True Sight at level 3.
Health: %warrior_health_tooltip%
Damage: %warrior_damage_tooltip%
Mana Break Damage: %warrior_mana_break_tooltip%
Last Will Damage: %explosion%

Health: %archer_health_tooltip%
Damage: %archer_damage_tooltip%
Aura Move Speed: %archer_move_speed%
Aura Radius: %archer_aura_radius_tooltip%
