name: Nemesis Curse
desc:
Passive: Glass Cannon Hero takes %debuff_self%% more damage from all sources.
Passive: Glassify When attacking a hero, apply a debuff increasing the damage received by that hero by %debuff_enemy%% for %debuff_enemy_duration% seconds. Only one target can be affected by Glassify at the same time.

name: Nether Shawl
lore: An otherworldly garment tethered to our plane by unknown means.

name: Ninja Gear
desc: Active: Solitary Disguise Casts Smoke of Deceit on yourself only that lasts for up to %duration% seconds.
lore: Valuable equipment recovered by a young explorer sifting through the flotsam and detritus drifting in the void.

name: Null Talisman
lore: A small gemstone attached to several chains.

name: Nullifier
desc:
Active: Nullify Dispels the target and applies a debuff for %mute_duration% seconds. Continuously dispels and slows the target.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: A dangerous weapon pilfered from an inverse dimension.

name: Oblivion Staff
lore: Deceptively hidden as an ordinary staff, it is actually very powerful, much like the Eldritch who originally possessed it.

name: Observer and Sentry Wards
desc: Use: Plant Plant the currently active ward.  Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
lore: Advancements in stacking efficiency have made wards easier to carry than ever.

name: Observer Ward
desc:
Use: PlantPlants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a %vision_range_tooltip% radius to your team. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.
lore: A form of half-sentient plant, often cultivated by apprentice wizards.

name: Occult Bracelet
desc: Passive: Rites of ElosharEach time the wearer is attacked, they gain a stack of %mana_regen% mana regen, up to %stack_limit% stacks. Stacks last for %stack_duration% seconds.
lore: A band that bears effigy of the dark goddess Eloshar's unsleeping eye.

name: Ocean Heart
desc: Passive: Water Regen Provides you with %water_hp_regen% HP regen and %water_mp_regen% mana regen while in the river.
lore: A charm blessed by the Council of the Brine.

name: Octarine Core
lore: At the core of spellcraft are spectrums only the very gifted can sense.

name: Ogre Axe
lore: You grow stronger just by holding it.

name: Ogre Seal Totem
desc: Active: Ogre Seal Flop Flop forward like an ogre seal %max_bounces% times, dealing %flop_damage% damage and slowing enemies in a %radius% radius by %slow%% for %slow_duration% second on each bounce. %leap_distance% bounce distance.

name: Orb of Blight
desc: Passive: Lesser Corruption Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
lore: An unnerving stone unearthed beneath the Fields of Endless Carnage.

name: Orb of Corrosion
desc: Passive: Corrosion Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor%, slows their movement by %slow_ranged%% (%slow_melee%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
lore: Seepage from the wounds of a warrior deity, sealed in an arcanist's orb following a campaign of vicious slaughter.

name: Orb of Destruction
desc: Passive: Impeding Corruption Attacks reduce the target's armor and movement speed. Slow amount varies based on whether the wearer is melee or ranged.
lore: An ingot of chaos suspended in wizard's ether, housed within an arcanist's orb.

name: Orb of Frost
desc: Passive: FrostYour attacks slow the target's movement by %slow_ranged%% (%slow_melee%% against melee targets), and reduces Health Restoration by %heal_reduction%%. Lasts for %duration% seconds.
lore: Slowly growing since the universe began, it will envelop everything when it ends.

name: Orb of Venom
desc: Passive: Poison AttackPoisons the target, dealing %damage% magical damage per second. Lasts for %poison_duration% seconds.
lore: Envenoms your veapon with the venom of a venomous viper.

name: Orchid Malevolence
desc: Active: Soul BurnSilences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.
lore: A garnet rod constructed from the essence of a fire demon.

name: Outworld Staff
desc: Active: Self-Exile Makes the caster completely invulnerable and disabled for %invuln_duration% seconds. When returning to the world, the caster takes %self_dmg_pct%% of their maximum health as damage.
lore: Proof that the lone sentinel was not always so.

name: Overwhelming Blink
desc:
Active: Overwhelming Blink Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage equal to %damage_base% + %damage_pct_instant%% of your strength and an additional %damage_pct_over_time%% over time, and have %movement_slow%% movement speed slow and %attack_slow% attack speed slow for %duration% seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: A horrifying dagger forged in the chaos maw and nigh untouchable by mortal hands.

name: Paladin Sword
lore: The sigil blade of the legendary Brother Yhols of Gausra, stripped from its scabbard on the day of his controversial excommunication.

name: Parasma
desc:
Passive: Witch Blade Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second.

Passive: Magic Corruption Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by %active_mres_reduction%% for %passive_cooldown% seconds.
lore: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.

name: Partisan's Brand
desc: Passive: Brand Increases spell damage dealt to player controlled targets by %bonus_damage_pct%%.

name: Pavise
desc: Active: Protect When cast on an ally, grants them a physical damage barrier that absorbs %absorb_amount% damage. Duration: %duration%s.
lore: Devised by a wizard who made one too many enemies.

name: Penta-Edged Sword
desc: Passive: MaimEach attack has a %maim_chance%% chance to reduce enemy hero movement speed by %maim_slow_movement%% and attack speed by %maim_slow_attack% for %maim_duration% seconds.
lore: The final, twisted work of a severely pious blacksmith, completed immediately before the taking of his own life.

name: Perseverance
lore: A gem that grants heart to the bearer.

name: Phase Boots
desc:
Active: Phase Gives %phase_movement_speed%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: Boots that allow the wearer to travel between the ether.

name: Philosopher's Stone
lore: A weightless charm created by an enchanter with a powerful scorn for brute force.

name: Phoenix Ash
desc: Passive: RebirthLethal damage is prevented and instead the wearer is healed to half health and non-ultimate ability cooldowns reset. Gets consumed on trigger.

name: Phylactery
desc: Passive: Empower Spell The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%% for %slow_duration%s.
lore: An amulet overflowing with powerful magics.

name: Pig Pole
desc: Active: Pig, Out!Turns your hero into a critter for %duration% seconds and gives them +%active_movespeed_pct%% Movement Speed.
lore: A makeshift charm misplaced by a peace-loving, addlebrained enchanter.

name: Pipe of Insight
desc:
Active: BarrierGives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies. Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.

Radius: %barrier_radius%

Passive: Insight Aura Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%% magic resistance.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: A powerful artifact of mysterious origin, it creates barriers against magical forces.

name: Pirate Hat
desc:
Passive: Plunder Steals %gold_steal_base% gold from enemy heroes that die within %gold_steal_range% units. If the wearer is the killer, there is no range limit and an additional %gold_steal_kill% gold is stolen.
Passive: Buried Treasure Gold loss on death reduced by %gold_loss_reduction%%.
lore: A salty skulltopper cursed with endless good fortune.

name: Platemail
lore: Thick metal plates that protect the entire upper body. Avoid dropping on feet.

name: Point Booster
lore: A perfectly formed amethyst that nourishes body and mind when held.

name: Pollywog Charm
desc: Active: Ribbit Increases the health regeneration of a target ally by %regen_boost% for %duration% seconds. While standing in water, the blessed unit also moves %water_movespeed%% faster.
lore: A tiny trinket that wriggles when wet.

name: Poor Man's Shield
desc:
Passive: Damage BlockGives a 100% chance to block %damage_block_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %damage_block_ranged% damage on ranged.

Has a %block_chance%% chance to block damage from creeps.
lore: A busted old shield that seems to block more than it should.

name: Possessed Mask
desc: Passive: LifestealHeals the attacker for %lifesteal% HP on each attack.
lore: Even when discarded with specific purpose and great care, this frightening mask always finds its way onto the face of a new owner.

name: Power Treads
desc:
Active: Switch AttributeSwitches between +%bonus_stat% Strength, +%bonus_stat% Agility, or +%bonus_stat% Intelligence.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: A pair of tough-skinned boots that change to meet the demands of the wearer.

name: Prince's Knife
desc: Passive: Hex Strike The next attack hexes the hit enemy into a frog for %duration% seconds.

name: Prophet's Pendulum
desc: Passive: Linger %delay_pct%% of incoming damage is delayed over %delay_time% seconds.

name: Psychic Headband
desc: Active: Psychic PushPushes the target unit away from you %push_length% distance.
lore: A failed experiment in finer telekinetic control, still fit for other ends.

name: Pupil's Gift
desc: Increases both non-primary attributes.
lore: An astounding plate of ever-replenishing, fortifying fruit.

name: Pyrrhic Cloak
desc: Active: Retribution For the next %damage_time% seconds, %damage_pct%% of damage taken by the caster is reflected to the target unit as physical damage if they are within %max_distance% units away.
lore: There are generals that care far less about the survival of their troops than the destruction of their enemies.

name: Quarterstaff
lore: A basic staff that allows you to strike quickly.

name: Quelling Blade
desc:
Active: Chop Tree Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %damage_bonus% for melee heroes, and %damage_bonus_ranged% for ranged.
lore: The axe of a fallen gnome, it allows you to effectively maneuver the forest.

name: Quickening Charm
desc: Passive: Cooldown ReductionReduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.
lore: An evergreen amulet of druidic origins.

name: Quicksilver Amulet
desc: Passive: QuicksilverGrants you a bonus %bonus_movement%% movement speed and %bonus_attack% attack speed anytime one of your abilities are on cooldown.
lore: An enchanted talisman brimming with a mysterious substance.

name: Radiance
desc:
Toggle: Burn When active, scorches enemies for %aura_damage% magical damage per second. Illusions deal %aura_damage_illusions% magical damage per second.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: A divine weapon that causes damage and a bright burning effect that lays waste to nearby enemies.

name: Rattlecage
desc: Passive: Reverberate After taking %damage_threshold% damage from any source, the wearer fires a projectile at up to %target_count% random enemies in a %radius% radius, prioritizing heroes, that deal %projectile_damage% physical damage and slow the targets movement and attack speed by %slow%% for %slow_duration%s.

name: Reaver
lore: A massive axe capable of tearing whole mountains down.

name: Refresher Orb
desc: Active: Reset CooldownsResets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Shard. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
lore: A powerful artifact created for wizards.

name: Refresher Shard
desc: Use: Reset CooldownsResets the cooldowns of all your abilities. Shares a cooldown with Refresher Orb. This item's cooldown only progresses in your hero's main inventory.
lore: Across an epoch of endless battle, the Immortal's will to triumph never faltered.

name: Repair Kit
desc: Use: Building Repair Targets a building, restoring %heal_percent%% of it's health over %duration% seconds. Also grants +%armor_bonus% armor during this period.

name: Revenant's Brooch
desc: Passive: Phantom CriticalGrants each attack a %crit_chance%% chance to deal an additional %crit_multiplier%% of the attack's damage as bonus magic damage.
lore: The cursed brooch of a fallen guardian who stalks forever between the veil of life and death.

name: Riftshadow Prism
desc: Active: Refract Spend %health_cost%% of your current life total to create a full health illusion that lasts for 20 seconds. The illusion has %outgoing_damage%% outgoing damage and takes %incoming_damage%% of incoming damage.

name: Ring of Aquila
desc:
Passive: Aquila AuraGrants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration and %aura_bonus_armor% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
Toggle: Aura Deactivate to stop affecting non-hero units.
lore: The ring of the fallen Warlord Aquila continues to support armies in battle.

name: Ring of Basilius
desc:
Passive: Basilius AuraGrants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: Ring given as a reward to the greatest mages.

name: Ring of Health
lore: A shiny ring found beneath a fat halfling's corpse.

name: Ring of Protection
lore: A glimmering ring that defends its bearer.

name: Ring of Regen
lore: This ring is considered a good luck charm among the Gnomes.

name: Ring of Tarrasque
lore: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component.

name: Ripper's Lash
desc: Active: FlayEmbeds thorns into all enemies in a %thorn_area% unit radius. Affected units take additional damage when attacked for %duration% seconds.
lore: The Fae horticulturists of Revtel are known to push the boundaries of both cross pollination and safety.

name: Robe of the Magi
lore: This robe corrupts the soul of the user, but provides wisdom in return.

name: Rod of Atos
desc: Active: CrippleRoots the target for %duration% seconds.
lore: Atos, the Lord of Blight, has his essence stored in this deceptively simple wand.

name: Roshan's Banner
desc:
Use: Place Banner Creates a banner at the target location. Lane creeps in the area of effect become damage immune while the Banner is up. Lasts %duration% seconds.

 Can be destroyed. Melee hero attacks deal 2x damage to the banner.

name: Royal Jelly
desc:
Active: Consume Consumes all charges and grants a target allied unit a buff that provides +%health_regen% Health Regen and +%mana_regen% Mana Regen per charge for %regen_duration%s.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
lore: To those who harvest olgru jelly, success serves more than mere profit--it's often the means to survival--for only the jelly itself can cure the ravages that follow a sting from the vigilant denizens of the giant hives.

name: Sacred Relic
lore: An ancient weapon that often turns the tides of war.

name: Safety Bubble
desc: Passive: Bubbled Up Equipped Hero has a %shield% HP Barrier against enemy damage. Barrier fully regenerates after not receiving damage for %restore_time% seconds. Self-inflicted damage bypasses the barrier.

name: Sage's Mask
lore: A mask commonly used by mages and warlocks for various rituals.

name: Sange
lore: Sange is an unusually accurate weapon, seeking weak points automatically.

name: Sange and Yasha
lore: Sange and Yasha, when attuned by the moonlight and used together, become a very powerful combination.

name: Satanic
desc:
Active: Unholy RageIncreases Lifesteal percentage to %unholy_lifesteal_total_tooltip%% for %unholy_duration% seconds.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: LifestealHeals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
lore: Immense power at the cost of your soul.

name: Scrying Shovel
desc: Active: DigSearch the map for Offerings to the dead.
lore: You don't know where it came from, but it knows where you need to go. All you need to do is dig.

name: Scythe of Vyse
desc:
Active: HexTurns a target unit into a harmless critter for %sheep_duration% seconds. The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed% and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.
lore: The most guarded relic among the cult of Vyse, it is the most coveted weapon among magi.

name: Searing Signet
desc: Passive: Burn Through Instances of magic damage from spells over %damage_threshold% ignites enemies, causing them to take %burn_damage% magic damage over %burn_duration% seconds. Burn damage against non-hero targets is decreased by %creep_penalty%%.
lore: To torture a magic user, one must devise means far beyond the mundane.

name: Seeds of Serenity
desc: Active: Verdurous Dale  Target the ground with a %radius% radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to %aura_health_regen% + %aura_health_regen_pct%% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts %duration% seconds.
lore: An evergreen sprout treasured by the woodkin and highly coveted by interlopers and their like.

name: Seer Stone
desc: Active: Reveal Reveal a target %radius% area of the map for %duration% seconds.
lore: The curious creation of a wizard who professed to hail from another time.

name: Sentry Ward
desc:
Use: Plant Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a %true_sight_range% radius.
Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.
lore: A form of plant originally grown in the garden of a fearful king.

name: Serrated Shiv
desc: Passive: Gut 'Em Attacks have a %proc_chance%% chance to have True Strike and deal %hp_dmg%% of the target's current health as bonus physical damage. Deals a flat bonus of %hp_dmg_rosh% against Roshan.
lore: Too dangerous for taskwork, this blade's only purpose is vile murder.

name: Shadow Amulet
desc: Active: FadeGrants invisibility to you or a target allied hero for %fade_duration%s. Movement speed during the invisibility is reduced by %movement_speed_reduction%%.
lore: A small talisman that clouds the senses of one's enemies when held perfectly still.

name: Shadow Blade
desc:
Active: Shadow WalkMakes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%% faster and can move through units.

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
lore: The blade of a fallen king, it allows you to move unseen and strike from the shadows.

name: Shiva's Guard
desc:
Active: Arctic Blast Emits a freezing wave that deals %blast_damage% magical damage to enemies and slows their movement by %blast_movement_speed%% for %blast_debuff_duration% seconds.

Radius: %blast_radius%

Passive: Freezing Aura Reduces the attack speed of all enemies by %aura_attack_speed%.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.

name: Silver Edge
desc:
Active: Shadow WalkMakes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While invisible, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%% faster and can move through units.

Attacking to end the invisibility will deal %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage, disable their passive abilities for %backstab_duration% seconds, and cap their movement speed to %max_movement_speed%.
lore: Once used to slay an unjust king, only to have the kingdom erupt into civil war in the aftermath.

name: Sister's Shroud
desc:
Passive: VeiledWhen falling below %hp_threshold%% HP, gain %evasion_max%% evasion for %max_duration% seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by %evasion_loss%% of its current value.
Passive: Last CaressVeiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.
lore: A pall that draped the sarcophagus of the First Sister.

name: Skull Basher
desc: Passive: Bash Grants melee heroes a %bash_chance_melee%% chance on hit to stun the target for %bash_duration% seconds and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus physical damage.  Bash chance for ranged heroes is %bash_chance_ranged%%.
lore: A feared weapon in the right hands, this maul's ability to shatter the defenses of its opponents should not be underestimated.

name: Slippers of Agility
lore: Light boots made from spider skin that tingles your senses.

name: Smoke of Deceit
desc:
Use: Disguise Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a %application_radius% radius invisible, and grants %bonus_movement_speed%% bonus movement speed for %duration% seconds.

 While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within %secondary_application_radius% range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

Attacking or moving within %visibility_radius% range of an enemy hero or tower, will break the invisibility.

Disguise grants invisibility that is immune to True Sight.

Smoke of Deceit is usable from the backpack and has no cooldown when swapped into the main inventory.
lore: The charlatan wizard Myrddin's only true contribution to the arcane arts.

name: Solar Crest
desc:
Active: ShineWhen cast on an ally, grants them %target_armor% armor, %target_attack_speed% attack speed, %target_movement_speed%% movement speed and a %absorb_amount% physical damage barrier.

Does not grant bonus armor, movement or attack speed if used on self.

Duration: %duration%
lore: A talisman forged to honor the daytime sky.

name: Soul Booster
lore: Regain lost courage.

name: Soul Ring
desc:
Active: Sacrifice Consume %AbilityHealthCost% health to temporarily gain %mana_gain% mana.  Lasts %duration% seconds.

If the mana gained cannot fit in your mana pool, it creates a buffer of mana that will be used before your mana pool.
lore: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

name: Spark of Courage
desc: Passive: Courage Provides %damage% damage when the hero is above %health_pct%% Health, and %armor% armor when they are below that threshold.
lore: A common battle charm in the armies that served the Children of Light.

name: Specialist's Array
desc: Passive: SplitshotRanged attacks have a %proc_chance%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%% damage of a normal attack.
lore: An impressive kit of trigger enhancements born in an aging assassin's idle mind.

name: Spell Prism
desc: Passive: Cooldown ReductionReduces the cooldown time of all spells and items.
lore: Even the slightest flaw in the components of a spell prism can result in the death of its user.

name: Spellslinger
desc: Passive: Salvo%mana_pct%% of the mana used to cast abilities is recovered over %duration% seconds.

name: Spider Legs
desc: Active: Skitter Grants you %bonus_movement_speed_active%% bonus movement speed, %turn_rate%% improved turn rate, and free pathing for %duration% seconds. Walking over trees causes them to be destroyed.
lore: A horrifying yet useful mixture of necromancy and artificing.

name: Spirit Vessel
desc:
Active: Soul Release When used against enemies, it reduces health by %enemy_hp_drain%% of current health per second, and reduces Health Restoration by %restoration_reduction_enemy%%. Deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second.

When used on allies, it provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration per second.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units or the user dies.
lore: Forged by a god to entrap the soul of another.

name: Staff of Wizardry
lore: A staff of magical powers passed down from the eldest mages.

name: Stonefeather Satchel
desc:
Toggle: Transmogrify Toggle to switch the contents of the Satchel between a pound of Feathers or Rocks.

Feathers: increase movement speed by %feather_movespeed% and distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by %knockback_resistance%%.

Rocks: increase armor by %rocks_armor% and decrease the distance of forced movement effects applied to the wearer by %knockback_resistance%%.

name: Stormcrafter
desc: Passive: Bottled Lightning Zaps %max_targets% enemy targets within %range% range, dealing %damage% damage and a %slow%% slow for %slow_duration% seconds.
lore: The accidental byproduct of a spell conjured to entrap a lesser god.

name: Stout Shield
desc: Passive: Damage BlockGrants a %block_chance%% chance to block %damage_block_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %damage_block_ranged% damage on ranged.
lore: One man's wine barrel bottom is another man's shield.

name: Stygian Desolator
desc: Passive: Greater Corruption Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.
lore: The original demonic favorite that served as basis for the beloved mortal design.

name: Swift Blink
desc:
Active: Swift Blink Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
lore: A cunning blade able to anticipate and enable its bearer's movements.

name: Talisman of Evasion
lore: A necklace that allows you to anticipate enemy attacks.

name: Tango
desc:
Use: Devour Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges.  Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
lore: Forage to survive on the battlefield.

name: Tango (Shared)
desc:
Use: Devour Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%
lore: Om nom nom.

name: Telescope
desc: Passive: Prescient Aura Lowers Scan cooldown by %scan_cooldown_reduction%% . Increases attack range (Ranged only) and cast range of allies in a %aura_range% unit radius.
lore: A handy tool that manages to make close what once was far.

name: The Leveller
desc: Passive: Level Attacks deal %demolish%% more damage to buildings.
lore: A demonic blade that struck the final blow to crack the gates of the Sanctum of Solanas.

name: Third Eye
desc:
Passive: True Sight Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %truesight_radius% range of its carrier.
Passive: Charge LossLoses a charge on death. After all charges are lost, the item disappears.

name: Tiara of Selemene
lore: A symbol of favor bestowed upon the high priestess of Selemene.

name: Tier 1 Token
desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 1 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

name: Tier 2 Token
desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 2 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

name: Tier 3 Token
desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 3 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

name: Tier 4 Token
desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 4 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

name: Tier 5 Token
desc: Activate to redeem a Tier 5 Neutral Item. The resulting neutral item isn't shareable and a hero can only redeem a single token per tier.

name: Timeless Relic
desc: Increases all outgoing spell damage and debuff duration.
lore: An unmarred discovery from the excavated ruins of an ancient wizard's academy.

name: Titan Sliver
lore: Though many desire this brilliant shard for its obvious qualities, a school of study exists to determine the true size and purpose of its incomprehensible whole.

name: Tome of Aghanim
desc: Use: Consume Temporarily grants an allied target the Aghanim's Scepter buff for %duration_minutes% minutes.

name: Tome of Knowledge
desc:
Use: EnlightenGrants you %xp_bonus% experience plus %xp_per_use% per tome consumed by your team after the first two.

Tomes Used By Team: %customval_team_tomes_used%
lore: That which raises beast to man and man to god.

name: Tomo'kan Ringcap
desc: Use: MunchInstantly restores %replenish_amount% mana + %mana_pct%% of the target's max mana when consumed

name: Town Portal Scroll
desc:
Use: TeleportAfter channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
lore: What a hero truly needs.

name: Tranquil Boots
desc:
Passive: Break Whenever you attack a hero or are attacked by any unit, the bonus %bonus_health_regen% HP regen is lost and the movement speed bonus is reduced to %broken_movement_speed% for %break_time% seconds.
Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
lore: While they increase the longevity of the wearer, this boot is not particularly reliable.

name: Trickster Cloak
desc: Active: CloakCauses you to become invisible for %duration% seconds.
lore: A fantastic garment immediately misplaced by its creator upon completion.

name: Trident
desc: Combines Sange, Yasha and Kaya together.

name: Trusty Shovel
desc:
Active: Dig Channel for %abilitychanneltime% second.
Can find a Bounty Rune, a Healing Salve, an Enchanted Mango, or a Kobold. If digging in a river, always digs up a Water Rune.
lore: Former plaything of a young deity, received as a gift from his uncle.

name: Tumbler's Toy
desc: Active: VaultPropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Tumbler's Toy gets disabled for 3 seconds if its owner receives damage from a player source.
lore: An antique plaything found in the ruins of an Ozenja circus bazaar.

name: Ultimate Orb
lore: A mystical orb containing the essence of life.

name: Unrelenting Eye
desc: Passive: RelentlessIncreases slow resistance by %max_slow_res%%. This bonus is reduced by %hero_reduction%% for every enemy hero within the wearer's attack radius.
lore: A serpent's eye the size of a melon (and just as moist).

name: Unwavering Condition
desc: Passive: Unwavering Hero's Max Health is set to %max_health% and can't be altered by other effects or attributes.

name: Urn of Shadows
desc:
Active: Soul Release Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
lore: Contains the ashes of powerful demons.

name: Vambrace
desc: Active: Switch AttributesActivate to switch the active attribute between Strength, Agility, and Intelligence. Vambrace provides +%bonus_primary_stat% of the selected attribute and +%bonus_secondary_stat% of the other two attributes.
lore: The coveted treasure that divided the heirs of Queen Raiya upon her death, resulting in the eventual downfall of her kingdom.

name: Vanguard
desc: Passive: Damage Block Grants a %block_chance%% chance to block %block_damage_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %block_damage_ranged% damage on ranged.
lore: A powerful shield that defends its wielder from even the most vicious of attacks.

name: Veil of Discord
desc:
Active: Spell Weakness Cast a %debuff_radius% radius blast that causes enemy heroes to take %spell_amp%% increased damage from spells.

Can be cast while channeling.

Duration: %resist_debuff_duration% seconds.
lore: The headwear of corrupt magi.

name: Vindicator's Axe
desc: Passive: Vengeance Provides %bonus_damage% damage if equipped hero is Silenced and %bonus_armor% armor if equipped hero is Stunned.

name: Vital Toadstool
desc:
Use: Munch Grants %health_regen_pct%% max health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

name: Vitality Booster
lore: A ruby gemstone that has been passed down through generations of warrior kin.

name: Vladmir's Offering
desc:
Passive: Vladmir's AuraGrants %lifesteal_aura%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
lore: An eerie mask that is haunted with the malice of a fallen vampire.

name: Void Stone
lore: Jewelry that was once used to channel nether realm magic, this ring pulses with energy.

name: Voodoo Mask
desc: Passive: Spell LifestealHeals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
lore: A mask tuned to sip the arcane bindings that pass between caster and foe.

name: Weighted Dice
desc: Passive: LoadedIncreases your base damage maximum by %bonus_max_damage%. When calculating your base damage or creep bounty from last hits, the value is computed %roll_count% times and the highest value is taken.

name: Whisper of the Dread
desc: Passive: Tunnel Vision Equipped Hero has their daytime vision reduced by %vision_penalty%% but their Spell damage increased by %bonus_spell_damage%%.
lore: The air that passes through this amulet makes a dreadful sound.

name: Wind Lace
desc: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.
lore: Hasten to battle on wind-touched heels.

name: Wind Waker
desc:
Active: Cyclone Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
lore: Proof enough to some that unseen forces manipulate the happenings of the material plane.

name: Witch Blade
desc: Passive: Witch BladeCauses your next attack to apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
lore: A spiteful blade inadvertently possessed by the soul of its incautious creator.

name: Witchbane
desc:
Active: CleanseDispel all enemies and allies in a %radius% unit radius.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Passive: SubjugateYour attacks deal bonus magical damage equal to %damage%% of your target's Max Mana.
lore: With ready access to test subjects, untold cruelties have been dreamed up and loosed upon the world from within the walls of the Tyler Estate.

name: Witless Shako
desc: Increases the wearer's max health, while reducing their max mana.

name: Woodland Striders
desc:
Active: Woodland Stride Create a path of trees behind you for %active_duration% seconds. Trees last up to %tree_duration% seconds.
Passive: Tree Walking Removes movement speed limit and allows free pathing through trees.

Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

name: Wraith Band
lore: A circlet with faint whispers echoing about it.

name: Yasha
lore: Yasha is regarded as the swiftest weapon ever created.

name: Yasha and Kaya
lore: Yasha and Kaya when paired together share a natural resonance.
